project_name.justification: The documents consistently refer to the project as the 'Loveland Nickel Property'. For example: 'STLLR Gold Announces Proposed Sale of its Non-Core Loveland Nickel Property to Loyalist Exploration'.

company_name.justification: The buyer in the transaction is identified as Loyalist Exploration Limited. 'STLLR Gold Inc. ... is pleased to announce it has entered into a binding letter of intent with Loyalist Exploration Limited ... to sell its interest in the Loveland Nickel Property'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Loyalist Exploration, is identified as Errol Farr. 'Errol Farr, Loyalist’s President & Chief Executive Officer commented, “We are very excited to announce the acquisition of the highly prospective Loveland Nickel property...'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Loyalist Exploration is acquiring a 100% interest in the property. 'Loyalist Exploration Limited. (CSE: PNGC) (“Loyalist” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce that the Company has entered into a binding letter of intent with STLLR Gold Inc. (“STLLR”) to acquire a 100% interest in the Loveland Nickel/Copper/Gold property (the “Property”)'.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is consistently referred to as the 'Loveland Nickel Property' and the transaction announcement highlights historical nickel resources. 'STLLR Gold Announces Proposed Sale of its Non-Core Loveland Nickel Property to Loyalist Exploration'.

verified_article_link.justification: The article at this link directly discusses the sale of the Loveland Nickel property from STLLR Gold to Loyalist Exploration, which is the primary transaction of interest.

currency.justification: The cash payment is specified in Canadian dollars. 'The letter of intent requires the parties to enter a definitive agreement on or before March 31, 2025 that will provide that STLLR receives for the Transaction: i) C$250,000 in an upfront cash payment...'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The transaction includes a cash payment of $250,000. 'The consideration to STLLR of the acquisition of the Property consists of an upfront cash payment of $250,000...'

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction includes the issuance of shares, but a specific dollar value for the share component is not provided.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The cash and share components are listed separately, not as a single combined value.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The transaction includes the issuance of 7,000,000 shares from the buyer. 'The consideration to STLLR of the acquisition of the Property consists of... the issuance of 7,000,000 of Loyalist common shares...'

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: There is no mention of share warrants as part of the transaction consideration.

option_payments_raw.justification: There is no mention of options as part of the transaction consideration.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued, but not the price. Using the last traded price for the buyer (Loyalist Exploration) as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.005'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: There is no mention of an exploration commitment in meters in the transaction between STLLR Gold and Loyalist Exploration.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The transaction for the sale of the property from STLLR to Loyalist does not include an exploration commitment. A $0.5 million commitment was part of a prior, separate transaction in 2023 where Moneta Gold consolidated the land package.

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: As part of the transaction, the seller, STLLR Gold, retains a 2% NSR. '...and STLLR retaining a 2.0% Net Smelter Royalty (“NSR”), providing Loyalist with a option to buy-back one-half of the NSR for $1 million.'

coverage_area_raw.justification: The total area of the acquired claims is specified as 6,244.28 hectares. 'These contiguous claims total 6,244.28 ha in area.'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the coverage area is specified as hectares (ha). 'These contiguous claims total 6,244.28 ha in area.'

resource_size.value: 422,350 short tons grading 0.71% Ni and 0.42% Cu and 130,000 short tons grading 0.73% Ni and 0.68% Cu
resource_size.justification: The property includes two historical estimates: 'Hollinger Zone, historical estimate of 422,350 short tons grading 0.71% Ni and 0.42% Cu.(1)' and 'Cominco Zone, historical estimate of 130,000 short tons grading 0.73% Ni and 0.68% Cu.(2)'.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified as Loyalist Exploration Limited with its ticker and exchange provided in the text: 'Loyalist Exploration Limited. (CSE: PNGC) (“Loyalist” or the “Company”)'.
